## Wave 2 Summary

Wave 2 discharges the FOURTH and final door (D4) of the §VII.CK SHAPE-branch homogeneity-obstruction genus. §VII.CK is the STRUCTURAL-ORTHOGONAL-COMPANION of the §VII.BL Generation-Blindness Obstruction (the MAGNITUDE branch) and §VII.BV (the SIGN branch), on the third γ₉/orientation functional axis. Its four-door disjunction closes D1–D3 CLOSED-INTERNAL (γ₉-graded odd-power trace ≡ 0; γ₉-graded even moment ⇒ C₂-only; A_K-built cyclic cocycle multiplicity-scalar by Skolem–Noether leg-membership). The one open door D4 is the **right-regular SU(3)_R connection** `Y_R = Σ_a c_a R_{X_a}` (≡ `δA_R`), the ONE candidate with non-scalar multiplicity-leg content (it escapes the `t(O)=0` D3 leg-membership wall and the D1 supertrace vanishing). S114 W-2 (van-den-dungen × baptista, CONVERGED R2, output form (ii) Reading-B) DECIDED it: D4 is **CLOSED-EXTERNAL-AS-A-COUPLING** — the SU(3)_R symmetry is substrate-internal (the COMMUTANT of `A_K`'s left-regular action, a real isometry `‖[L_g,Y_R]‖_F = 7.25e-17`), but its fermion coupling is admissible only via the canonical crossed product `A_K ⋊ SU(3)_R` (≡ Kasparov external product), OUTSIDE `Ω¹_{D_K}(A_K)` by the `t(O)=±1≠0` center-character selection rule (W3-1 residual = 1.000000 EXACT is its numerical shadow).

This wave's single gate is the Stage-2 two-agent blind cross-axis independent-verify of that D4-external JOINT clause. On PASS-AND across both axes, the FUTURE-gate upgrade owed by the registry entry is discharged: §VII.CK is re-scoped from STAGE-1-CANDIDATE to **STAGE-3-PERMANENT-UNCONDITIONAL** (the genus complete as a statement about `A_K`-INTERNAL couplings). The carry-forward source is `CF-S115-VIICK-D4-DISCHARGE-UNCONDITIONAL`, lifted verbatim-equivalent from the S114 W3 WP CF block (mirroring the W-2 workshop CF-1) into `session-115-context.md`.

This gate is the SECOND of two distinct Stage-2 verifies on the SAME §VII.CK registry slot, verifying a DIFFERENT clause from W1-1: W1-1 (`CF-S115-VIICK-STAGE2-VERIFY`) verifies the D1–D3 closed-class wall and flips STAGE-1-CANDIDATE → STAGE-3-PERMANENT (D4-open RETAINED); W2-1 (this gate) then verifies the D4-external clause and re-scopes STAGE-3-PERMANENT → STAGE-3-PERMANENT-UNCONDITIONAL. The two gates are NOT conflated — distinct clauses, distinct gate IDs, sequenced.

## Wave 2 Decision Point Prerequisites

**Upstream prerequisite (MANDATORY pre-registration)**: W2-1 DEPENDS on W1-1 (`S115-VIICK-STAGE2-VERIFY`, Wave 1, this session) landing its D1–D3 → STAGE-3-PERMANENT flip on the SAME §VII.CK registry slot FIRST. The dependency is read at dispatch time from the W1 verdict file `computations/session-115/s115_gate_verdicts.txt` (grep gate-ID `S115-VIICK-STAGE2-VERIFY`).

- **If W1-1 = PASS** at W2 dispatch time → W2-1 runs as the full Stage-2 cross-axis verify (the gate block below). On W2-1 PASS-AND, the §VII.CK slot re-scopes STAGE-3-PERMANENT → STAGE-3-PERMANENT-UNCONDITIONAL.
- **If W1-1 ≠ PASS** (FAIL / INFO / absent / superseded-to-non-PASS) at W2 dispatch time → W2-1 routes to **PRE-REG-INC mechanical closure** per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md §"When mechanical closure IS acceptable"`. This is a plan-ANTICIPATED prereq-block scenario (item 1: the plan author HAS anticipated it here; the closure is NOT post-hoc plan editing). The closure script emits `value='PRE-REG-INC_blocked_by_S115-VIICK-STAGE2-VERIFY_<status>'` (FAIL/PRE-REG-INC, NEVER PASS per item 2), updates the WP §W2-1 section IN THE SAME RUN (Status/Verdict/Results/Substrate-framing per item 5), and defers the D4-UNCONDITIONAL discharge to S116. The §VII.CK slot remains at the W1-1-determined state (STAGE-1-CANDIDATE or STAGE-3-PERMANENT-D4-open); D4 stays `CLOSED-EXTERNAL-AS-A-COUPLING pending` (NO UNCONDITIONAL flip).

Because Wave 2 contains exactly ONE gate, the mechanical-closure covered-count is 1 (< `N_PLANNING_DEFECT_THRESHOLD = 4` per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md §"PLANNING DEFECT"`); a prereq-block closure here is NOT a planning-defect signal — it is the correct sequenced-dependency behavior between W1-1 and W2-1.

This wave consumes NO S114 (or earlier) verdict beyond the registered §VII.CK entry text and the named static inputs in the Input-SHA Ledger; the only live cross-wave dependency is the same-session W1-1 prerequisite above.

# (7) substitution_chain — mandatory for the t(O)=±1≠0 selection-rule direction claim
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim (DIRECTION): the right-regular root operator R_{E_α} (carrying SU(3)_R triality
    weight t(O)=±1) is EXCLUDED from Ω¹_{D_K}(A_K) — i.e. it is OUTSIDE the A_K differential
    calculus and is admissible only as an EXTERNAL coupling via the crossed product
    A_K⋊SU(3)_R — because 0 ≠ ±1 (mod 3) group-theoretically forbids it.

    Definition 1 (center character / triality): for an SU(3) irrep (p,q),
      t(p,q) = (p − q) mod 3   ∈ {0, 1, 2}     [registry §VII.BL line 21124, proven_384;
      STAGE-3-PERMANENT; the Z₃ center character of SU(3), = generation index on the
      multiplicity leg ℂ^{m(p,q)} of H_K = ⊕_{(p,q)} V_{(p,q)} ⊗ ℂ^{m(p,q)}].
    Definition 2 (selection rule for a matrix element): a triality-weight-t(O) operator O
      has a NONZERO matrix element ⟨ψ_a | O | ψ_b⟩ between sectors of triality t(a), t(b)
      ONLY IF the admissibility congruence holds:
        t(a) ≡ t(b) + t(O)   (mod 3)
      [center-character/triality CG-admissibility; the trivial rep must occur in
      a* ⊗ O ⊗ b; NECESSARY condition — a FAILED congruence proves the element 0 EXACTLY.
      Canonical project use: session-101-plan-w8 selection-rule transcription;
      math-scripts.md §"Selection-rule pre-flight for pre-registered nonzero matrix elements".]
    Definition 3 (A_K one-forms are coset-preserving): every element of Ω¹_{D_K}(A_K) is a
      finite sum Σ a₀ [D_K, a₁], aᵢ ∈ A_K. Each [D_K, a] maps into ⊕ B(V_{(p,q)}) ⊗ 1_{m(p,q)}
      (Skolem–Noether leg-membership, registry lines 21120/21155, the D3 closing fact); it acts
      WITHIN each Peter-Weyl sector, hence is triality-PRESERVING: its effective center character
      is t(O) = 0 (it does NOT shift the (p−q) mod 3 coset). [D3 row, registry L22438.]
    Definition 4 (the right-regular root operator R_{E_α}): E_α is a NON-Cartan (root) generator
      of su(3)_R; the right-regular R_{E_α} acts on the multiplicity leg ℂ^{m(p,q)} and SHIFTS the
      triality coset by the root's weight ⇒ t(R_{E_α}) = ±1 (a cross-generation handle that moves
      (p−q) mod 3 by ±1). [D4-disposition annotation, registry L22460: "the cross-generation handle
      SHIFTS triality cosets, t(O)=±1".]

    Substitute (plug Def 3 and Def 4 into the Def 2 admissibility congruence, no simplification):
      For R_{E_α} to lie in Ω¹_{D_K}(A_K) it would have to be expressible as a sum of A_K one-forms,
      each of which (Def 3) carries effective t(O) = 0. A sum of t(O)=0 operators has t(O)=0.
      But R_{E_α} (Def 4) carries t(O) = ±1. Membership in Ω¹_{D_K}(A_K) therefore requires
        t(R_{E_α}) = 0      [forced by Def 3, the only triality available inside the A_K calculus]
      simultaneously with
        t(R_{E_α}) = ±1     [Def 4, the actual triality of the root operator].

    Simplify (one step):
      0 = ±1   (mod 3)        [equate the two forced values of t(R_{E_α})]
      ⇒ 0 ≡ ±1 (mod 3) is FALSE   (1 ≢ 0 and 2 ≢ 0 in ℤ/3ℤ).

    Canonical form:
      t(R_{E_α}) = ±1 ≠ 0 = t(any A_K one-form)   in ℤ/3ℤ.

    Direction (read-off): the triality of the root operator (±1) does NOT match the triality of
      ANY A_K one-form (0). The mismatch is EXACT and discrete (an integer-mod-3 inequality, not a
      small number) ⇒ R_{E_α} is group-theoretically EXCLUDED from Ω¹_{D_K}(A_K) at EVERY L_max,
      A_F-INDEPENDENTLY (the obstruction is a center-character statement about SU(3)_R vs the
      A_K-left calculus; it does not reference the finite algebra A_F). The ONLY admissible home
      for R_{E_α} as a fermion coupling is OUTSIDE the A_K calculus — the canonical crossed product
      A_K⋊SU(3)_R (≡ the Kasparov external product), where SU(3)_R enters as the external acting
      group rather than as inner fluctuations of D_K.

    Conclusion: D4 is CLOSED-EXTERNAL-AS-A-COUPLING. The SU(3)_R symmetry is substrate-internal
      (the commutant of A_K's left action, ‖[L_g,Y_R]‖_F = 7.25e-17, a real isometry); only the
      COUPLING is external (admissible via A_K⋊SU(3)_R). The W3-1 residual = 1.000000 EXACT is the
      numerical shadow of this t(O)=±1≠0 exclusion (the root operator's image is fully OUTSIDE the
      left A_K calculus). With D4 discharged external, the genus
      {A_K-built ∪ Casimir-graded ∪ γ₉-traced ∪ right-regular} is COMPLETE as a statement about
      A_K-INTERNAL couplings ⇒ §VII.CK UNCONDITIONAL on PASS-AND. (Cross-reviewers verify this
      direction from first principles; the chain is pre-flighted here so the producing-script
      readback of W3-1 residual==1.000000 is a CONFIRMATION cross-check, not a discovery.)

PASS_meaning: >

  D4-external JOINT clause AND their respective single-axis legs (logical AND). The right-regular
  R_{E_α} SHAPE handle is verified external-as-a-coupling (outside Ω¹_{D_K}(A_K) by t(O)=±1≠0,

  real isometry). The §VII.CK homogeneity-obstruction genus is COMPLETE as a statement about

  (the FUTURE-gate upgrade the registry entry owes is discharged). Solution-space: closes the last
  internal door on the SHAPE branch; the fermion-mass SHAPE texture's only home on this axis is the
  named external crossed-product corridor.
FAIL_meaning: >

  Stage-2 → STAGE-3-PERMANENT-UNCONDITIONAL promotion is BLOCKED; §VII.CK stays at the
  W1-1-determined state (STAGE-3-PERMANENT with D4-open RETAINED), D4 stays CLOSED-EXTERNAL-AS-A-
  COUPLING *pending* (NO UNCONDITIONAL flip). The FAILing clause routes to S116 remediation. A FAIL
  is a §VII.CK D4-disposition COUNTEREXAMPLE (the S114 W-2 CONVERGED-R2 reading is challenged on a
  first-principles axis), NOT an agent inadequacy — it re-opens the D4 reading for re-audit.
INFO_meaning: >
  At least one reviewer returns INFO (no FAIL) on the D4-external JOINT clause — e.g. the clause is
  PASS-eligible but a reviewer flags a scope caveat (finite-L_max image overlap, or a
  reading-dependence between 'external-as-a-coupling' and an off-Casimir internal route) requiring a
  named follow-up. §VII.CK stays at the W1-1-determined state; D4 stays CLOSED-EXTERNAL-AS-A-COUPLING
  pending; the INFO clause is documented as a Stage-2-INFO-deferred item (joint-theorem-promotion.md
  Stage-2 INFO criterion). NO UNCONDITIONAL flip. ALSO the upstream-block outcome: if W1-1 ≠ PASS at
  dispatch, this gate closes PRE-REG-INC (mechanical closure, value='PRE-REG-INC_blocked_by_
  S115-VIICK-STAGE2-VERIFY_<status>') — a plan-anticipated prereq-block, deferred to S116.

## Wave 2 → (next session) Decision Point

Wave 2 is the final SHAPE-branch genus-completion gate; it has no in-session downstream wave consuming its verdict. The branching at session close:

- **W2-1 PASS-AND** → §VII.CK is STAGE-3-PERMANENT-UNCONDITIONAL on disk (the closeout's single-shot tag-flip landed). The EVOI rank-9f frontier row `D4-RIGHT-ROOT-SU(3)_R-ADMISSIBILITY` (= the in-queue discharge, `session-115-context.md` §"Phase 1c-REGISTERS") is retired; atlas-08 Q18b carries the SHAPE-branch genus-completion freshness. No carry-forward owed (the genus is complete). The named external corridor's residue is tested by `CF-S115-LEPTON-PMNS-FORCED-TEXTURE` (a SEPARATE gate consuming the external-coupling verdict, NOT the genus flip).
- **W2-1 FAIL** → §VII.CK stays STAGE-3-PERMANENT (D4-open); the FAILing clause is a 4-field carry-forward to S116 (`CF-S116-VIICK-D4-RE-AUDIT`: re-audit the challenged D4 leg from the FAILing reviewer's first-principles objection; input = the FAIL clause-verdict + the §VII.CK D4-disposition; gate = a re-dispatched Stage-2 verify on the challenged leg; effort = ~1 wave). The S114 W-2 CONVERGED-R2 D4 reading is re-opened, NOT silently down-tagged.
- **W2-1 INFO** → §VII.CK stays STAGE-3-PERMANENT (D4-open); the INFO clause is a Stage-2-INFO-deferred 4-field carry-forward to S116 (close the named scope caveat — e.g. the finite-L_max crossed-product-image overlap or the external-vs-off-Casimir reading-dependence).
- **W2-1 PRE-REG-INC (upstream-blocked)** → W1-1 did not land PASS; D4-UNCONDITIONAL discharge defers to S116 as a 4-field carry-forward (`CF-S116-VIICK-D4-DISCHARGE-UNCONDITIONAL`, re-run once W1-1's D1–D3 STAGE-3-PERMANENT flip lands). The mechanical-closure verdict + WP update are on disk; the audit trail names the blocking prereq.
